# Task status

**Generated by `npm run status` from `docs/backlog.md` §1.2. Do not edit by hand.**

Status is recorded in the ledger and verified by `npm run check:status`, which
fails the build if a task is marked `done` while the tests named in its own
"Done when" column are absent from the suite, or while a task it depends on is
unfinished. See `specs/testing.md` §9A (`T-STATUS-001`).

(c) the committed HEIC carried **real lat/lon into a public repo** and was redacted in place by `redact-gps.mjs` — only the two ref characters and six lat/lon rationals overwritten with a public landmark, no offset or length changed, so container, EXIF layout, IFD0, device model, XMP, raster and the other 11 GPS tags are byte-identical to what the iPhone wrote. ⚠ Also falsified a **spec** premise: invariant 11 / ASM-058 reason from "iOS screenshots are normally PNG", but the owner's own screenshot is **JPEG** with an EXIF block and no GPS. The conclusion (accept all three, sniff by magic bytes) is unchanged and strengthened; the stated rationale was wrong and is corrected at ASM-058. | `T-IMG-013`, `T-IMG-015`, `T-IMG-016`, `T-IMG-023`, `T-PASTE-006`, `T-SEC-032`, `T-SEC-033` |
